title: pvWriteXMLUniformGridAMRWriter
body:
## pvWriteXMLUniformGridAMRWriter

Explicit-export writer for adaptive-mesh-refinement data (vtkUniformGridAMR, overlapping or non-overlapping): it writes a .vthb index file plus one VTK XML image file per AMR block in a companion folder, keeping levels, refinement ratios, block extents and all arrays. Schemaxis reopens the set (asking the reader for all levels) and requires an exact match. Automatic geometry already writes .vthb for overlapping AMR; choose this writer for encoding or header-size control or an explicit export receipt. pvWriteXMLHierarchicalBoxDataWriter is the deprecated name of the same format.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Keep the .vthb file and its data folder together; the index refers to the block files by relative path.
- ChooseArraysToWrite true is rejected at planning (ARRAY_SELECTION_UNVERIFIABLE) because the exact comparison needs every input array in the file; filter arrays with pvPassArrays and export that node. ChooseBlocksToWrite true is rejected at planning (BLOCK_SELECTION_UNVERIFIABLE) because no comparison accepts missing blocks; extract the blocks to keep with pvExtractBlock and export that node.
- Schemaxis switches off the writer's TimeValue field array unless you author WriteTimeValue, so the exact comparison sees only the node's own arrays; the selected time is kept in the export receipt.
- An earlier catalogue run (verification/2026-09-16-catalogue-expansion.json, writerQualification) passed only on a small serial fixture with WriteTimeValue false and the other options at their defaults; no current native acceptance check is recorded, so verify the export on representative data.

Native constructor: `XMLUniformGridAMRWriter`. Identity: `writers/XMLUniformGridAMRWriter`. Role: `writer`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Connect upstream object to `Input` | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkUniformGridAMR"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Assembly` | Select which assembly is used when specifying selectors to choose blocks to extract. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `CellDataArrays` | Select the cell data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ChooseArraysToWrite` | Explicitly choose which arrays to write. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ChooseBlocksToWrite` | Explicitly choose which blocks to write. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `CompressionLevel` | A compression performance parameter from 1 (faster/larger compressed filesize) to 9 (slower/smaller compressed filesize). | `{"type":"enum","values":["1","2","3","4","5","6","7","8","9"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"1"` |
| `CompressorType` | The compression algorithm used to compress binary data (appended mode only). None offers fastest write, LZ4 offers fastest compressed write, ZLib offers balanced performance, LZMA offers smallest compressed filesize. | `{"type":"enum","values":["None","LZ4","ZLib","LZMA"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"None"` |
| `DataMode` | The mode uses for writing the file's data i.e. ascii, binary, appended binary. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Ascii","Binary","Appended"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Ascii"` |
| `EdgeDataArrays` | Select the edge data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `EncodeAppendedData` | When EncodeAppendedData is turned ON, the writer uses base64 encoding when writing binary data (only if appended mode is selected). | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `FieldDataArrays` | Select the field data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `HeaderType` | Integer width of the size headers that precede each binary data block in the XML files. UInt64 allows arrays larger than about 4 GiB; UInt32 gives slightly smaller files that some older VTK readers require. Values are unchanged either way. | `{"type":"enum","values":["UInt32","UInt64"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"UInt32"` |
| `PointDataArrays` | Select the point data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `RowDataArrays` | Select the row data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `Selectors` | Specify the selectors for the data assembly chosen using **Assembly** to choose the blocks to extract from the input dataset. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `VertexDataArrays` | Select the vertex data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `WriteTimeValue` | When WriteTimeValue is turned ON, the writer write field data time values information, if any. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Output publication contract:

```json
{
  "comparison": "exact",
  "extensions": [
    "vthb"
  ],
  "filenames": "managed output directory",
  "losses": [],
  "qualification": "requires fixture",
  "time": "one scheduled state"
}
```

```json

  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "explicit exports with semantic readback",
  "outputPorts": 0,
  "qualification": "not-run"

```

### Syntax example

Place in `scenes[].exports`; writers cannot be graph nodes. The main data input is `node`; non-data ports go in `resources`.

```json
{
  "id": "exportResult",
  "node": "DATA_NODE",
  "writer": "pvWriteXMLUniformGridAMRWriter"
}
```
